positions.name: CalibrationVerificationAuthority
positions.frame: What arbitrates calibration correctness here — the instrument's own reported status, or verification against a fixed external reference standard?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration status, but each grounds that assertion's correctness in verification against the June reference plates rather than in the speaker's own say-so — the narrative prose (src-1) and the two structured field-label restatements (src-2, src-3) differ in format (free sentence vs. bolded protocol fields) but not in this directional move: competence and validity are performed by citing an external standard the plates arbitrate, not by assertion alone. The set holds the tension between the discursive framing (src-1) and the terse, template-driven record (src-2, src-3) without resolving it — both are read as the same deference-to-standard move in different registers.
